landing.title: Role workspace
landing.summary: Review the exact responsibilities assigned to this deterministic role. No credential, customer record, or administrative authority is connected.
landing.scopeBody: Navigation is projected from the canonical route manifest and excludes every cross-role responsibility.

support.title: Support case review
support.summary: Read and prepare a response for a synthetic case without exposing a customer identity or sending a message.
support.subject: Startup guidance after a Windows update
support.detail: The synthetic report contains a startup state and no uploaded diagnostic payload.
support.responseHint: The subject is the only safe draft field. Response text is cleared when the review is cancelled.
support.cancelled: Response draft cancelled. No message was sent and no remote event changed.
support.purpose: Prepare a scoped response for the synthetic support case.
support.impact: A future submission would send only the reviewed response to the case. This preview sends nothing.

operations.title: Operations review
operations.summary: Triage a synthetic release-control alert and review proportional action safeguards without changing an operational system.
operations.detail: The fixture reports a manifest mismatch. Publication remains blocked and no artifact is promoted.
operations.purpose: Keep the synthetic release held while evidence is reviewed.
operations.impact: A future authority could retain the hold for one release object. Phase 3 cannot alter publication state.
operations.mobile: Alert triage and evidence review remain available on mobile. Confirmation requires at least 960px.

security.title: Security review
security.summary: Inspect a synthetic risk alert and prepare an object-specific response without accepting a security credential.
security.detail: A synthetic request exceeded the expected retry window. No account, token, address, or diagnostic value is present.
security.purpose: Prepare containment review for the synthetic security alert.
security.impact: A future authority could limit one identified session. This preview cannot revoke, block, or mutate it.

diagnostics.title: Consent-scoped diagnostics
diagnostics.summary: Diagnostic detail stays closed unless purpose, permitted fields, expiration, actor, and immutable audit reference all match this object.
diagnostics.blockedBody: No valid consent covers this diagnostic object. Metadata below explains the required scope without revealing diagnostic or customer data.
diagnostics.requiredPurpose: Review startup evidence for case SUP-2048
diagnostics.denial: Absent, expired, or wrong-scope consent reveals no diagnostic field and creates no authority.

audit.title: Immutable audit timeline
audit.summary: Correlate complete synthetic events. Records are frozen after generated-contract validation and every target remains redacted.
audit.caption: Synthetic immutable administrative events

receipt.title: Preview complete — no change was made
receipt.body: The review reached the disconnected Phase 4 boundary. No remote state changed; the receipt and correlated audit record remain synthetic and immutable.

recovery.title: Administrative capability unavailable
recovery.offline: The disconnected authority is offline. Safe review remains available and no request is queued.
recovery.stale: The synthetic record is stale. Refresh it before any future confirmation.
recovery.expired: The preview session expired. No credential or sensitive draft was retained.
recovery.permission: This role does not include the requested responsibility. No data was disclosed.
recovery.failure: The preview boundary did not respond. No remote state changed.
recovery.safeDraft: Only the synthetic case subject is eligible for local recovery. Response and diagnostic fields are discarded.
